title: 1890s Main Street looking north. John T G Carr's house on right
description: This view looks down Station Street (later King, known today as Orser Street) toward the Keith & Plummer Store. On the left are David Morgan’s meat shop, the Gillin building, and the C. Humphrey Taylor Block with its colored glass cupola, followed by Keith & Plummer. On the right are a shoe repair shop and residence, as well as John T. G. Carr’s home on Main Street, with his store directly across from his house. A northbound train is just leaving the station.
